annotations.title: Get the Go Rocket plan checkout link

description: Returns the checkout link for the Go Rocket plan (monthly credits for finished videos). Call it once the sample is 'ready'. Opening the link in a browser is the only step that charges; the sampled site becomes the first video. After payment the person signs in to Go Rocket once when this connection asks, and from then on create_video makes finished videos directly in this chat.
